def: The quality or state of being venerable; venerableness. Dr. H.More.
A nickname for a Nova Scotian.
One who observes or considers; an observer. [R.] Goldsmith.
An imposition; a cheat; a hoax. Garrick.To relieve the tediumbams. Prof. Wilson.
See Orichalch.Costly oricalche from strange Phoenice. Spenser.
An order of sessile-eyed Crustacea, usually having seven pairsof legs, which are all similar in structure.
A mineral of a green color and pearly luster; a hydrousphosphate of copper.
Having young that are naked when hatched; psilopædic; -- saidof certain birds.

In the terminology of the United States Weather Bureau, anunusual fall in temperature, to or below the freezing point,exceeding 16º in twenty-four hours or 20º in thirty-six hours,independent of the diurnal range.
